frameStoragePolicy: Generated full-resolution frame derivatives are git-ignored. Commit this manifest and reports, not binary frames.

extractionPolicy.frameSelectionBasis: Prompt 87 selected-menu evidence ranges plus direct 1fps contact-sheet review. Source timestamps are deterministic offsets inside stable selected-label ranges.
extractionPolicy.angleLabelPolicy: MENU is menu evidence. Other view labels are approximate from rotation sequence and require verifier confirmation before production use.
extractionPolicy.notificationOverlayPolicy: Overlays are not edited out. Prompt 87 record-level overlay flags are carried into the manifest, but frame-level overlay detection is not implemented; reviewers must inspect extracted frames before production use.
